title: ExtremeBody Solo #55 (스틸레토 · 솔로 · 산호·조개 붉은 산호 · 앵글 기본(허리 높이) · 조명 fire · 시간대 없음 · 분위기 high fashion editorial · 체형 USSBBW · 인종 blue-black · 헤어 tight cornrows · 메이크업 푸시아 립 강함 · 배경 플라네타륨 로비 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman seated.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s, Yemaya, the Yoruba ocean mother goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, tight cornrows in natural black — full body carved deep red coral and iridescent mother-of-pearl fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid coral and shell curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted coral sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep red branching coral relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID iridescent pearl-white nacre sections shimmering pink and gold between the coral, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: seated on a long upholstered bench with her legs crossed at the ankle, one hand resting on her thigh — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, plain stiletto pumps in solid coral red smooth polished leather, each with a very tall razor-thin tapered heel and a hidden front platform, seated with her legs stretched impossibly long and extended out in front of her so the towering heels project into plain view.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT coral — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid fuchsia-red lips, soft pink eyeshadow, defined lashes, a flushed pink blush.

Background: a bright planetarium lobby with a polished pale floor, a curved white wall, a standard-height door and a low step, firelight, warm flickering flames, dramatic orange glow, high fashion editorial mood, cold sophisticated atmosphere, sharp luxury, every person's whole figure from the shoes to the top of her head clearly lit and fully visible with every material detail sharp, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly in view. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
